task.title: To create a flow to retrieve and display Opportunities
task.shortdesc: Rakesh Singh Example Click Action Flow and then click Create .

step.cmd: Click Action Flow and then click Create.
Enter Retrieve Opportunities into the Action Flow Name field and click Apply. The left-hand window is updated.
In the Step Name field, type Select Account. From the Action list, select Select Account.
Select the check box next to the Persist Data as Output check box and enter Account in the Action Output field.
Click Apply and then click Add Step.
In the Step Name field, type Query Opportunities.
From the Action list, select Query Opportunities.
Select the check box next to Persist Data as Output and enter Opps in the Action Output field.
Select the check box next to Provide Input and then select Account from the picklist.
Click Apply and then click Add Step.
In the Step Name field enter Display Opportunities and select Display Opportunities from the Action list.
Select the check box next to Provide Input and select Account and Opps from the Action Input list.
Click Apply and then click Save.
